published.source: Race re-pick 2026-10-27 (standards 29 and 16): Undead (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_shock); verify.py, 20000 iterations, seed 1 (was 963.8 as a Human on the same sim); rotation 2026-10-27: vigilSwing 25 (was 965.2), verify.py 20000 iterations, seed 1

summary: The Holy Shock build with Exorcism, for an Undead or Demon boss. It saves more mana for Light's Vigil in long fights.
advantage: Exorcism and Holy Wrath only work on Undead and Demons. This build adds Exorcism to its Holy Shock rotation.
advantageShort: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons, so it joins the Holy Shock rotation.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3s, Light's Vigil at -1.5s
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target, mana is at or above 30% and the next swing is more than 2s off (its cast resets the swing)
Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown below 30% mana; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed) is taken by rule (standards 26). It costs 2.2 / 2.8 / 2.5 at 120 / 180 / 300s.
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
A missed Holy Shock wastes the Vigil (about 1% Holy miss).
Holy Strike's flat bonus is inside the weapon percent (client data). Unconfirmed on the beta.
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% at stake).
Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once (70425 tooltip). Counted twice it would be 46-51 DPS higher. At the proc spell's 0 it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive (standards 11): the Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 6.1 at 180s, the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 6.8 (each 1s cast resets the swing).
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_shock except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_shock).
